3509062568.description:
This bug was fixed in 6.3, so you don't need this mod anymore.
---------------------
This mod fixes the repeated unique item quest bug of the vanilla game, and this bug may also cause the spawning of repeated unique characters and event quests.

The core issue lies in errors with saved values of Lua scripts during saving and loading of the game, leading to saved files losing records of whether certain quests or events have been triggered. The root cause is that there is a limit to the length of a single stored string entry; when this limit is exceeded, the entry should be split into parts for storage. However, CA's scripts fail to implement this logic properly. As a result, the more Lua mods you use (especially those like Recruit Defeated Legendary Lords), or the more endgame crises you enable (which also involve numerous saved values), the more prone you are to encountering this bug.

Note: This bug affects save files at the time of saving, so the mod is only effective for save files that have not yet encountered this issue.

Special thanks to 齐神武破阵 and 萌新 525 for their testing and save files.
3509062568.title: [Fixed in 6.3] Repeating Quest for Unique Items Bug Fix

3760606729.description:
This replaces SEU_miaoying_submod_extension, and seu_generic_content do not use them both at the same time.

                                     ^^^^   READ THE ABOVE   ^^^^

A tinkered with updated version of the old Seu Miao Ying mod.
Changes are at Miao Ying stage 3 you will get the Yuanshan Fu confederation dilemma instead of the complicated old way of doing it. Miao Ying will have daughters you can have as lord or heroes, The magical plug of destiny works too and so on and so forth we all know what the mod does by now. requires the usual miao ying mods of course.

>>>UPDATED<<< I have now added the Seu generic mod into this one. Adds a few other minor dilemmas that involve Kat or Miao Ying. Katarina at her stage 4 and Miao Ying at her stage 6 they arent that exciting frankly but felt I should add them. They should pop off every 10 turns or so.

With the update Yuanshan Fu will now be able to trigger her dilemmas off of fighting Chorfs.

Updated to allow the YuanShan Fu dilemma to occur when she's already been confederated by Miao Ying.

Changed the Zhao confederation event to merely vassalize the dork instead. No more of that compendium breaking confederation shenanegans

Made Fully compatible with Azazel Realm.

Seu Dilemmas will trigger as Azazel when Miao Ying has reached stage 6 and been confederated into his faction. Everything works the same from then on apart from the Zhao Confederation dilemma being pushed back 10 turns after the confederation.A Yuanshan Fu mini dilemma pops up after you defeat the Azazel vs Miao Ying quest battle that gives Azazel a chance to turn her faction into a vassal or to confederate her.

Friendly reminder that any issues you have is probably you forgetting to download the workshop version of corrupted landmarks and using the old version.

This mod pairs well with the Miao Ying Keeper of Secret mod found here https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3756385010.

Soft Compatible with Murranji's Great Bastion Expansion Mod >>>IF<<< you do not choose to have the bastion defenders manage themselves. 

Update 1) Modified the head of Miao Yings daughter in the image because Kerb told me to.
